status.current: supervises Hagun students at the debrief and referees Kuraudo versus Moroboshi

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former examinee whose growth makes her want to apologize and congratulate him.
relationships.toka-todo: Student council president she advises about real combat risk and vacation.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Problematic fighter whose spar she referees and is ready to stop if needed.

periods.summary: Oreki explains to the girls why special conscription should end once professionals can handle the remaining fugitives: real combat lacks tournament safety systems and student deaths would be unacceptable. She reflects on Ikki's entrance exam and admits that Ikki has disproved her fear that he was unsuited to being a knight. Later, despite comic blood-loss from misunderstandings, she serves as referee for Kuraudo and Moroboshi's training spar and stops the match when Moroboshi can no longer continue.

key_events.summary: Explains the risks of real combat and the end of student authority.
Referees the spar and declares Kuraudo's win.
